entries.27d8d5f8ebfcab97: COMTURE CORPORATION and 5 consolidated subsidiaries, 6 companies in total, form the group and operate in a single segment, the Solutions Service Business. To address customers' challenges and needs, it uses digital technology to provide total solutions covering IT system consulting, construction, maintenance, operation and education. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥38,109 million, and consolidated employees numbered 1,964 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.36d642d4827b43c7: Working with global vendors, it provides IT system consulting, construction, maintenance, operation and training as an integrated offering across five businesses: cloud, data and AI, core business systems, platform and operation, and digital learning. It provides services by combining consulting and construction at system introduction with maintenance and operation after introduction, in a cycle.
entries.389407ef0919db2b: It is a single segment, the Solution Services Business, and revenue by business is Business Solutions Business ¥14,555 million, Cloud Solutions Business ¥9,695 million, Platform and Operation Services Business ¥6,336 million, Digital Solutions Business ¥5,793 million and Digital Learning Business ¥1,728 million, in that order. Revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue, and no counterparty accounts for 10% or more of consolidated revenue within revenue from external customers. Corporate investment in digital areas is expanding, and customer needs are said to be diversifying, including support using new technologies such as generative AI and outsourcing of operations.

entries.bdbd84dfb35fe0e4: A feature is that collaboration with global vendors, including Microsoft, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Google Cloud, Amazon Web Services and SAP, serves as a foundation common to the five businesses. It has a delivery model that balances one-time work, such as consulting and construction at system introduction, with ongoing work, such as maintenance and operation after introduction, in a cycle, and it also has a business partner system that deploys engineers flexibly according to project requirements. Having an IT training company within the group, which enables talent development in-house, also supports the business.

entries.ca5f74cfd0525d14: Under the theme of “creating the future with AI and digital,” the company aims to grow into a company with revenue of ¥100 billion, and under its medium-term management plan (fiscal years ended March 2026 to March 2028), it says it will address key challenges: growth into an AI-native company, strengthening deal creation capability and expanding growth foundations through M&A, strengthening human capital and organization, and strengthening sustainability and governance systems. The MD&A states that its strategy to achieve revenue of ¥100 billion in the fiscal year ending March 2032 centers on strengthening collaboration with global vendors, combining its own templates and solutions as added value, and supporting customers’ business model transformation.

entries.f05d9fbf43e7fd63: In the current consolidated fiscal year, the company acquired shares of Hyūman Interakutibu Tekunorojī Co., Ltd. on June 30, 2025 and made it a consolidated subsidiary, establishing a structure to provide consistent services from AI introduction consulting through operational support. On the personnel side, it hired 58 mid-career employees and 158 new graduates joining in April 2026, and advanced their development using programs of the group’s IT training company. The year is positioned as one in which initiatives were advanced in line with the key challenges of expanding the AI foundation and strengthening human capital and organization.
